API Quality Engineer

Fictional Lantern Platform

FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION FOR APP TESTING

Own API regression coverage for a service-oriented application, working with backend engineers and release teams.

REQUIRED

- Test REST methods, status codes, payload schemas and authentication failures.

- Design negative cases, stateful CRUD flows and isolated test data.

- Build maintainable Python tests and diagnose flaky automation.

- Integrate API tests into CI and report actionable failures.

- Use SQL to validate persisted results.

NICE TO HAVE

- Containerized test environments.

- Performance-testing fundamentals.

INTERVIEW STAGE

Initial hiring manager interview about experience and testing approach.
